title: Business Capability Catalog Entry
description: Schema for entries in technehub-labs/dea-catalog-business-capabilities. Mirrors technehub-labs/dea-metamodel/schemas/entities/capability.json conventions; catalog extensions per docs/FOUNDATIONS.md section 12 as amended by CR-DEA-BC-01A. Established by CR-DEA-BC-03.

type.description: Kind by entity specialization (dea-metamodel ADR-015): every entry in this catalog is a dea:BusinessCapability by catalog scope. capability_type is deprecated upstream and never appears here (CR-DEA-BC-01A).

purpose.description: Why the capability exists, distinct from definition (what it is) and outcome (what it contributes to). Recommended (CR-DEA-BC-43 M-1): populate only with authored, evidence-backed narrative -- never bulk-generated -- per the remediation policy in docs/BUSINESS-CAPABILITY-RECORD-MODEL.md.

outcome.description: The meaningful business outcome this ability produces, enables, controls, preserves or realizes.

business_object.description: The business object or domain the ability is concerned with (Object Focus test, METHODOLOGY.md section 4).

capability_layer.description: Governed enumeration (dea-metamodel ADR-015 section 5, vocabulary E005). Optional.

maturity.description: Optional. Upstream capability.json requires maturity_level without defining it or its vocabulary (CR-DEA-BC-03 finding U2); this catalog carries an optional annotation only and invents no scale.

ecf.description: ECF coordinates are classification metadata, never a kind classifier (CR-DEA-BC-01A). Primary marks earliest initiation (METHODOLOGY.md section 8).

secondary.description: Legitimate participation in other stages; honest, not exhaustive.

held_unmapped.description: True when the mapping is legitimately absent (CR-DEA-BC-02 section 38 clause; CAND-019 precedent).

related_capabilities.description: Recorded associations between canonical capabilities. Two forms (CR-DEA-BC-53): a bare canonical id (legacy/untyped association -- semantics unresolved pending evidence-led typing), or a typed assertion {id, type, rationale}. Types are governed by the entity-system registry (ES-003 canonical_types); an id must not appear in both forms within one record.

realization.description: Links to constructs in sibling catalogs; realization never redefines the capability (METHODOLOGY.md section 3).

processes.description: Realizing processes. When populated (CR-DEA-BC-43 M-2), entries carry canonical ids of the sibling processes catalog (processes:*); prose entries are not accepted.

actors.description: Realizing actors; canonical sibling-catalog ids when available (id scheme pending U-2).

resources.description: Realizing resources; canonical sibling-catalog ids when available (id scheme pending U-2).

systems.description: Realizing systems; canonical sibling-catalog ids when available (id scheme pending U-2).

information.description: Realizing information entities; canonical sibling-catalog ids when available (id scheme pending U-2).

aliases.description: Alternate names reconciled by normalization decisions (TAXONOMY.md section 2). An alias never becomes a separate entry.

provenance.description: Recorded passage through the seven-stage evidence ladder (METHODOLOGY.md section 6); admission goes through the review gates (section 12). The post-mv1 admission flow appends the evidence-seeded and admitted checkpoints after reviewed (CR-DEA-BC-23; schema-reconciled by CR-DEA-BC-40).

admission_cr.description: CR that admitted the capability (post-mv1 admissions; CR-DEA-BC-23).

evidence_seed_cr.description: Research-CR that seeded the evidence track (post-mv1; CR-DEA-BC-19).

why_capability.description: Why this is a durable ability rather than a process, unit, or technology (METHODOLOGY.md section 11).

loop_closure_narrative.description: Narrative recording an explicitly-closed loop obligation (e.g. BC-SR-A001 section 16 direction loop; CR-DEA-BC-23).

ecf_rationale.description: Why the primary coordinate is what it is. (CR-DEA-BC-mv1: 1000 -> 1280; namespaced ids are up to ~20 chars longer than legacy dea:* ids and rationale prose cites them inline.)

oneOf.description: What the capability includes and excludes (plain form).

Structured boundary (CR-DEA-BC-29 rich-narrative form). Applicability (CR-DEA-BC-43 M-3): use the structured form only where a rich-narrative justification exists (e.g. governance-object distinctions or closed-loop contexts); the plain string remains the default.

non_examples.description: Adjacent constructs explicitly out of scope (process, system, organization, outcome).

specialization_boundary.description: What industry specializations may legitimately refine (TAXONOMY.md section 4).

ecfConformance.description: ECF Conformance Gate manifest (CR-ECF-CG-001..003). Declares the catalog's CONFORMANT-WITH-EXTENSION status, the canonical ECF references that resolve, and the catalog-specific extensions (kebab-case display vocabulary, multiple contextual coordinates, held-unmapped state). Schema-level shape is permissive; scripts/check_ecf_conformance.py enforces the contract.

external_references.description: Identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id.

metamodel_pin.description: Pins the entry to a specific dea-metamodel version (CR-DEA-BC-05 section 4.4). Optional for backwards compatibility with pre-v1-alpha.0 entries; the CI version guard (scripts/check_versions.py, C4) requires the field on every entry under v1-alpha onward.
